pillars.title: Our Vision
pillars.summary: The heart of SFC in four words, as the church describes itself.
pillars.body:
“Loving God. Loving People.” is how Spiritwind Fellowship Church introduces itself. Everything we do flows from these two great commandments.

Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart… Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. (Matthew 22:37, 39, KJV)

verses.text: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind… Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof… so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you.

steps.title: Head to the CMS Building
steps.text: We meet on the 4th floor of the CMS Building along National Highway.

steps.title: Arrive a little before 9:00 AM
steps.text: Sunday Celebration starts at 9:00. Coming early gives you time to find a seat.

steps.title: Worship, Word and fellowship
steps.text: Praise and worship, a message from the Bible, then time to meet the family.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.text: Let us know you're new. We'd love to pray with you and answer any questions.
